name: NGINX | Install & Configure
content:
- hosts: all
  tasks:
    - apt:
        name: nginx
        state: latest
    - name: Copy config
      copy:
        src: nginx.conf
        dest: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
      notify: restart nginx
    - name: Reload
      shell: systemctl reload nginx
      ignore_errors: true

name: Linux | Baseline Hardening
content:
---
# Amaç: Linux sunucular için CIS baseline sertleştirme
# Sahip: SecOps
- name: Linux | Baseline Hardening
  hosts: "{{ target_hosts }}"
  become: true
  vars_files:
    - vars/hardening.yml
  pre_tasks:
    - name: Validate inputs
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that: target_hosts is defined
  tasks:
    - name: Harden sshd config
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: sshd_config.j2
        dest: /etc/ssh/sshd_config
        mode: "0600"
      notify: Restart sshd
      tags: [ssh]
  handlers:
    - name: Restart sshd
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: sshd
        state: restarted

name: Payment API | Deploy
content:
---
# Amaç: Payment API deploy
- name: Payment API | Deploy
  hosts: payment_api
  become: true
  tasks:
    - name: Fetch artifact
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ artifact_url }}"
        dest: /opt/payment/app.jar
      tags: [deploy]
    - name: Write env file
      ansible.builtin.template:
        src: app.env.j2
        dest: /opt/payment/.env
      tags: [deploy]
    - name: Restart app
      ansible.builtin.command: systemctl restart payment
      tags: [deploy]
